description: This file defines the 'MethodSignatureComparer' class, which implements comparison and equality checks for method symbols within the Orleans code generation project. It provides methods to compare method signatures for equality, generate hash codes, and order method symbols, primarily used for deduplication or sorting based on method signatures.

classes.name: MethodSignatureComparer
classes.description: A sealed class implementing equality and comparison logic for method symbols based on their signatures, including method name, type arguments, and parameter types.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks if two IMethodSymbol instances have the same signature including name, type arguments, and parameter types.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code for an IMethodSymbol based on its name, type arguments, and parameter types.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Provides order comparison between two IMethodSymbols based on name, type arguments, and parameter types.
